name: Dependent Children Pension Scheme - Punjab
nodalDept: Department of Social Security and Development of Women and Children
briefDescription: Punjab State Government started a pension for Dependent Children of the state.
descriptionMd: The main objective behind launching Dependent Children Pension Scheme is to provide financial security cover to those childrens whose income is not stable due to non availability of his/ her father/ parents. This Scheme is implemented by Social Security and Women & Child Development Department of Punjab Government. Eligible Beneficiary will get Monthly Pension direct to their bank account.
eligibilityMd:
1. Applicant should be a Permanent Resident of Punjab.
1. Annual Income of Parents/ Guardian should not be more than Rs. 60,000/- per Year.
1. The Age of Child should be below 21 Years.
1. Mother/father or both have passed away or parents regularly absent from home or have become physically /mentally incapacitated to look after the family.
applicationMd:
**Step-1:** Applicants have to visit the [official website](https://connect.punjab.gov.in/service/citizenservice/116).
**Step-2**: Click on the "Click to apply services".
**Step-3**: Now login on Digital Punjab portal with Email/Phone number and password. If does have any account then register [here](https://ssocitizen.psegs.in/register)
**Step-4:** Fill out the application form.
**Step-5**: Attach the required documents
**Step-6**: Submit.
